subject: Cobalt rollout — final sequencing, doc owners, and product clarifications
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Kevin Park <kevin@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cobalt rollout — final sequencing, doc owners, and product clarifications

Team —

We need to lock the final sequencing for the Cobalt rollout by EOD Friday so Acme has a firm integration window. Two quick product asks before I publish the rollout timeline to the broader stakeholder list:

1) Feature gating: Product requested we either gate semantic-caching behind the new cache-key schema (A) or do a runtime toggle (B). Marissa — what's the risk profile (integrations + testing) and which do you recommend if we want a canary next week?

2) Docs ownership: The staging runbook (attached) still has a number of TBDs in the cutover and rollback sections. Please own the sections below — I assigned tentative owners in the doc but want explicit confirmation:
  - Cutover checklist: Lauren
  - Monitoring & alerts: Rishi
  - Customer communication cadence: Marissa

Acme has asked for a 2-hour maintenance window on 10/22; if we cannot commit to the full window they want a staged fallback plan. Kevin, putting you on the loop so you know where we are — we should confirm by Friday.

Attachments: cobalt_staging_runbook_v2.pdf

Action: Can each of you reply with (a) gate choice A or B and a 1-2 line rationale, (b) confirm doc ownership or propose alternatives, (c) whether the 10/22 window is feasible or whether we need to propose a shorter window.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Kevin Park <kevin@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cobalt rollout — final sequencing, doc owners, and product clarifications

Vivek —

Quick answers:

1) Gate choice: I recommend B (runtime toggle) for the canary next week. Reason: the cache-key schema change (A) requires gated client-side changes and adds ~3 days of validation across integrations; runtime toggle lets us ship server-side and flip on for the canary cohort while retaining a clear rollback path.

2) Doc ownership: Confirmed — I will own customer communication cadence and the external messaging templates. I've started a short playbook for outage vs brief maintenance language.

3) 10/22 window: Tentatively OK for the 2-hour block, but we should plan a staggered approach if we anticipate any throttling. I attached a small canary matrix (canary_matrix_v1.xlsx) that maps cohorts by traffic slice — suggests a 30/60/120 minute ramp for the first three cohorts.

Notes:
- We'll need a clear signal in metrics for semantic-caching errors (404 vs degraded latency) — Rishi, can you confirm the alert sensitivity?
- Lauren, if engineering still needs the cache-key schema for forward compat, let's identify a fast follow PR after the canary.

Thanks — I'll update the runbook with the communication templates after I get Rishi's alert numbers.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior PM, Product Launches
Redwood Inference

Attachments: canary_matrix_v1.xlsx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cobalt rollout — final sequencing, doc owners, and product clarifications

Vivek / team —

Confirming engineering constraints and proposed fallback:

- Runtime toggle (B) is the least risky for the canary. We can implement a feature-flag-backed path that bypasses the new cache-key logic for flagged traffic. Development estimate: 2 engineer-days to complete feature gate and 1 day for internal integration tests.

- If we discover data-mismatch during canary, rollback plan: disable runtime toggle (instant), revert canary cohorts, and re-route traffic to legacy cache path. The runbook needs explicit steps for cache invalidation — I added TODOs in the attached runbook but will push a small PR with commands and expected system states today.

- Monitoring: we will publish a small dashboard with three primary signals: 1) 95/99th latency for generation route, 2) cache hit ratio, 3) error rate for semantic-caching. Rishi — I'll need the alert thresholds from you by EOD so I can wire alerts.

One ask: if we go with runtime toggle, we should still version the cache-key schema internally and include a migration note in the dev-facing ops doc so that future rollouts don't accidentally assume the new schema is universal.

Lauren Bishop
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Kevin Park <kevin@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cobalt rollout — final sequencing, doc owners, and product clarifications

Thanks all — summary / decisions and next steps: 

Decisions (locked):
- Gate: runtime toggle (B) for next-week canary.
- Canary cadence: follow Marissa's 30/60/120 minute ramp per the attached matrix.
- Owners: Cutover checklist -> Lauren (will add PR with commands today); Monitoring & alerts -> Rishi (please provide thresholds by EOD); Customer comms -> Marissa (will finalize templates).

Open actions (owners + dates):
- Rishi: post proposed alert thresholds and a short runbook snippet for what to do on elevated error rate (by EOD 10/15).
- Lauren: push the PR with cache invalidation commands and update runbook (by EOD 10/15).
- Marissa: update the staging_runbook (cutover + comms) and publish final PDF / Drive folder (by 10/16).
- Ops: schedule on-call rotation for the 10/22 maintenance window and confirm with SRE (I'll handle scheduling and notify Kevin after confirmation).

Kevin — we'll confirm timing once Rishi and Lauren post their items today; I expect a short follow-up note tomorrow with the final published runbook and the Drive link. Thanks for your patience — we'll minimize customer impact and provide a clear rollback path.

Vivek
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
